note: Canonical anti-slop rule registry. Skills and docs cite ids (ASR-nnn); they do not copy the statement. Run: node scripts/anti-slop/run.mjs validate

rules.title: No serif fonts in product code
rules.statement: Product code must not introduce serif fonts.
rules.rationale: Deterministic subset of the frontend-skill taste contract (JOV-7759).

enforcement.coverageNote: Diff mode only; apps/web/{app,components,styles} and packages/ui tsx/jsx/css. Not run on data/, content/, HTML artifacts or Pen.

rules.title: No emoji or Unicode checkmarks in UI
rules.statement: Use a text label or the canonical icon, never emoji or Unicode checkmarks.
rules.rationale: Deterministic subset of the frontend-skill taste contract (JOV-7759).

enforcement.coverageNote: Diff mode only; apps/web/{app,components,styles} and packages/ui tsx/jsx/css. Not run on data/, content/, HTML artifacts or Pen.

rules.title: Hover changes paint only
rules.statement: Hover may change paint only: no translate, scale, offset, size, padding or border-width.
rules.rationale: Deterministic subset of the frontend-skill taste contract (JOV-7759).

enforcement.coverageNote: Diff mode only; apps/web/{app,components,styles} and packages/ui tsx/jsx/css. Not run on data/, content/, HTML artifacts or Pen.

rules.title: Transition only what changes
rules.statement: No transition-all; transition only the properties that change.
rules.rationale: Deterministic subset of the frontend-skill taste contract (JOV-7759).

enforcement.coverageNote: Diff mode only; apps/web/{app,components,styles} and packages/ui tsx/jsx/css. Not run on data/, content/, HTML artifacts or Pen.

rules.title: No text below 12px
rules.statement: Text below 12px is off the type scale.
rules.rationale: Deterministic subset of the frontend-skill taste contract (JOV-7759).

enforcement.coverageNote: Diff mode only; apps/web/{app,components,styles} and packages/ui tsx/jsx/css. Not run on data/, content/, HTML artifacts or Pen.

rules.title: No hover-only affordance
rules.statement: A control revealed on hover must also reveal on focus.
rules.rationale: Deterministic subset of the frontend-skill taste contract (JOV-7759).

enforcement.coverageNote: Diff mode only; apps/web/{app,components,styles} and packages/ui tsx/jsx/css. Not run on data/, content/, HTML artifacts or Pen.

rules.title: Semantic color tokens only
rules.statement: Never hardcode a color when a semantic token exists.
rules.rationale: Deterministic subset of the frontend-skill taste contract (JOV-7759).

enforcement.coverageNote: Diff mode only; apps/web/{app,components,styles} and packages/ui tsx/jsx/css. Not run on data/, content/, HTML artifacts or Pen.

rules.title: No native select for certified design
rules.statement: Native <select> cannot certify a selection design; use the canonical select owner.
rules.rationale: Deterministic subset of the frontend-skill taste contract (JOV-7759).

enforcement.coverageNote: Diff mode only; apps/web/{app,components,styles} and packages/ui tsx/jsx/css. Not run on data/, content/, HTML artifacts or Pen.

rules.title: Marketing images and cards are rounded
rules.statement: Marketing images and cards use a radius token. Square corners and raw lengths fail. Full-bleed hero start, logos, icons and round avatars are exempt.
rules.rationale: Deterministic subset of the frontend-skill taste contract (JOV-7759).

enforcement.coverageNote: Diff mode only; apps/web/{app,components,styles} and packages/ui tsx/jsx/css. Not run on data/, content/, HTML artifacts or Pen.

rules.title: One accent per surface
rules.statement: Marketing surfaces use one accent role.
rules.rationale: Marketing art direction must read expensive and consistent.

rules.title: One hue per plate; no orange wash
rules.statement: A plate has one dominant hue; a second non-adjacent hue or orange mass fails.
rules.rationale: Marketing art direction must read expensive and consistent.

rules.title: Plates are smooth and declare an accent
rules.statement: Generated plates stay under the smoothness residual cap and declare accent ion|ultra|pulse in a sidecar.
rules.rationale: Marketing art direction must read expensive and consistent.

rules.title: No fake product UI in generated images
rules.statement: A generated image must never depict product UI. Sidecar kind generated-ui fails; undeclared fake UI is caught by the mockup-quality judge.
rules.rationale: Marketing art direction must read expensive and consistent.

enforcement.coverageNote: Static part only trusts the declared sidecar kind; vision part is shadow.

rules.title: Restrained hero with a scroll contract
rules.statement: Heroes follow the MKT-D03 scroll contract.
rules.rationale: Marketing art direction must read expensive and consistent.

rules.title: One boxed width, one full-bleed override
rules.statement: Marketing uses one boxed container width plus a single full-bleed override.
rules.rationale: Marketing art direction must read expensive and consistent.

rules.title: Canvas, WebGL and video are scoped on marketing
rules.statement: Canvas, WebGL and video appear only on declared surfaces.
rules.rationale: Marketing art direction must read expensive and consistent.

rules.title: Copy is the message, never the brief
rules.statement: Page copy must not leak briefs, prompts or internal planning language.
rules.rationale: Agent-written copy leaks its own instructions.

rules.title: General pages stay generic
rules.statement: Homepage, pricing, about, brand and other general pages never name a customer segment. Audience routes are an explicit allowlist.
rules.rationale: Broad positioning; MKT-D16.

rules.title: No AI-writing tells in copy
rules.statement: No em or en dashes, filler openers or other slop tells in user-facing copy; @jovie/copy is the only executable rule set.
rules.rationale: Slop copy reads as machine-written.

enforcement.coverageNote: Runs on registered writing surfaces only (scripts/invariants/writing-surfaces-registry.json); PR bodies and founder HTML are not covered.

rules.title: Generic SaaS composition is rejected
rules.statement: Reject generic card grids, centered-everything layouts, decorative blobs, purple-blue gradient defaults, icon-in-circle feature grids and copy that could describe any product.
rules.rationale: The canonical anti-slop list; every other copy of this sentence should cite this id.

rules.title: No emoji or symbol on a colored square
rules.statement: Decorative icons stay unboxed; semantic color goes on the title text, not an icon tile.
rules.rationale: Reads as consumer-grade AI slop.

enforcement.check: planned static: icon tile with bg color wrapper

rules.title: No all-caps eyebrow by default
rules.statement: Do not use all-caps labels, eyebrow text or section headers as a default styling move.
rules.rationale: Linear-level restraint.

enforcement.check: planned static: uppercase + tracking-wide utility on non-canonical components

rules.title: No music-cliche imagery
rules.statement: No microphones, headphones, DJ decks, vinyl, guitars, stages or crowds with phones in imagery. The real product UI or abstract on-brand plates carry the page.
rules.rationale: Cheesy and cheap; must feel expensive.

enforcement.check: banned imagery tags in asset sidecars (PR2) + vision:cliche

rules.title: Approved people only
rules.statement: No person imagery on any surface unless the person is in the approved-people registry with consent and provenance (today: Tim White only).
rules.rationale: Imagery of people implies real users or endorsement.

rules.title: Restrained marketing type scale
rules.statement: Marketing headings follow a Linear-precision scale: no billboard sizes. The single claim statement jov.ie/you is the only large exception.
rules.rationale: Consumer oversized type reads cheap to high-earning artists.

rules.title: No text on text or busy art
rules.statement: UI text never overlays artwork that contains text or a busy region; text sits outside the image bounds unless the image is known text-free.
rules.rationale: Overlay on lettered cover art looked bad in the real render.

rules.title: Claims must be registered
rules.statement: Every factual, numeric or comparative claim on a public surface maps to a registered claim with evidence and a re-measure date.
rules.rationale: Unregistered claims are invented proof.

enforcement.check: claims-registry coverage (PR2); offer-claims guard in PR #23144

rules.title: No "fan" language
rules.statement: Jovie sends verified events only; use audience, not fan. The share-with-artist toggle unlocks export, ads and artist messaging.
rules.rationale: Audience permission model.

rules.title: Optical and grid alignment
rules.statement: Spacing is token-only on a 4px beat; rendered bounding boxes align within 0.5px; nested radius equals outer minus padding.
rules.rationale: Misalignment is the most visible cheapness tell.

enforcement.coverageNote: Native spacing only; no rendered bounding-box check yet.

rules.title: Pen masters and code instances do not drift
rules.statement: Pen designs use instances of the canonical master; token values match code; stills match within threshold.
rules.rationale: Instance drift (#23326) breaks the Pen and code canonical program.

enforcement.coverageNote: Token parity and stills only; instance-override drift (#23326) not detected.

rules.title: Agent and realtime UI by default
rules.statement: A button that starts an agent conversation beats a multi-setting form. Deep settings stay reachable in one step.
rules.rationale: Forms push work onto the user; an agent does the work and explains it.

enforcement.check: human review + vision:hierarchy; static flag planned: new route or component with more than N form fields and no agent-entry affordance

rules.title: Design-system tokens and dark-first in artifacts
rules.statement: HTML artifacts and founder-facing pages use semantic design-system tokens only (no raw colors) and are dark mode first.
rules.rationale: Interim artifacts are scaffolding for Ovie, not separate products.

rules.title: No invented customers or proof
rules.statement: Never invent customers, avatars presented as customers, logos, metrics or testimonials.
rules.rationale: Fake proof is a trust failure.

enforcement.check: covered in part by ASR-024 and ASR-027

rules.title: Writing judged by calibrated readers
rules.statement: Customer-facing writing passes the Jev writing-quality evaluator before send.
rules.rationale: Machine review for prose (JOV-6476).

rules.title: No redundant chrome
rules.statement: Read the parent container before adding a title, header, card or label; do not duplicate chrome the container provides. Subtract before decorating.
rules.rationale: Linear-like density.

rules.title: No motion effect ships without a reduced-motion rest state, a static fallback and a perf budget
rules.statement: Every canvas, WebGL or scroll-driven motion effect on marketing is registered in docs/design-system/motion-effects.json with a prefers-reduced-motion rest state, a static fallback and a gzip, frame-rate and offscreen-pause budget.
rules.rationale: Motion carries the story between scenes and must never cost the page: the rest state is the designed state, the budget keeps it cheap.

source.ref: Motion and shader language spec, docs/design-system/motion-effects.json

rules.title: Sentence case for settings and shell headings
rules.statement: Use sentence case for generic words in settings and app shell headings.
rules.rationale: Settings headings should use plain language and consistent casing.

enforcement.coverageNote: Literal title attributes in settings routes and components/shell TSX; bounded generic words, exact-line shrink-only baseline. Dynamic labels and other copy remain under existing copy rules.
